Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere, you take online grocery orders on the final part of their journey: from the delivery location to the customer's front door. At the beginning of your shift, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route prepared for you. Once you are ready, you head out to your first address. Navigation guides you between customers in Almere and the surrounding area. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and check it with a handheld scanner. You then carry the grocery crates to the customer's door. You make sure every order is handed over in a friendly and professional way. If a payment needs to be processed, you take care of it. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you leave. Then it is time for your next delivery. You will spend plenty of time behind the wheel, but this is not a job where you sit down all day. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and carrying grocery crates are all part of a normal shift. Once your final order has been delivered, you return to the Almere location. You complete the route, return your equipment and leave the van ready for its next shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as acourier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will train you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How flexible are the working hours? You can submit your availability and work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday, with shifts available at different times of the day. You need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is this an active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of the role. Throughout your shift, you regularly get in and out of the van and carry grocery crates to customers. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity while working. Are there opportunities to develop? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy. In this role, you help new delivery drivers during their first working days. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and helpful towards customers. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Breda as a delivery driver through Consolid. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work a flexible 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training during your first working days. Support from an experienced buddy while learning the job. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role and become a buddy yourself. A varied position combining driving, customer contact and physical activity. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Breda Your job is to make sure Albert Heijn Online customers in Breda and the surrounding area receive their groceries safely and correctly. Before heading out, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route planned for your shift. Once everything is ready, you leave for your first address. Throughout the day, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and use a handheld scanner to check the groceries. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door. A good delivery is also about service. You greet the customer, hand over the order and help if there are any questions. Depending on the delivery, you may process a payment or collect empty crates and returnable packaging. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to your next stop. This means your working day is not spent sitting behind the wheel. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. Driving and physical activity naturally alternate throughout your shifAfter the final delivery, you return to the Breda location. You complete your route and leave the van ready for the next driver. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a courier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will guide you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How many hours can I work? You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week and submit your availability. Albert Heijn Online delivers seven days a week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is driving the only part of the job? No. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also be physically active and have regular contact with customers. You scan orders, carry grocery crates to the door, collect empty crates and help customers when necessary. Are there opportunities to grow? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy and help new delivery drivers learn the job. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Breda You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. Interested in combining driving with an active and varied job? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Breda. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
